args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. Rolled back all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After rollback, the service reports healthy and the error rate is 0.2%. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging before v2.3.1 went to production. Follow-up: find the root cause in v2.3.1 before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged the on-call engineer.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1, the latest deploy, was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west with an 18% error rate. v2.3.0 was the most recent release that had been healthy in production, so I rolled back to it. All three regions now run v2.3.0, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback and the recovery. It also notes that the test version of this release (v2.3.1-rc) was already unhealthy in staging before v2.3.1 went to production. The incident lists finding the root cause in v2.3.1 as the follow-up before anyone redeploys it.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
